# Super PTC Mode · 超级 PTC 模式
`@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode` is a configuration-only DSH profile bundle. Installing it adds one agent
preset, **Super PTC Mode** (id `super-ptc`): the shipped **ptc** composition — PTC tool presentatio
n — plus a preset-scoped persona suffix that carries the **SUPER PTC** Agent Teams delegation doctri
plus a preset-scoped persona suffix that carries the **SUPER PTC** Agent Teams delegation doctrine.
Repository: <https://github.com/zouyuanqing/dsh-super-ptc-mode>
本包是纯配置的 DSH Profile Bundle：安装后新增 Agent 预设「超级 PTC 模式」（id `super-ptc`）。它保留 PTC 呈现——模型只直接调用 `run_code`，
其余工具在程序内以生成 SDK 的形式调用——并在预设作用域内追加「超级委派」系统提示，要求 Lead 先拆分独立工作流、建立共享任务、派生有界队友，验证产物后再收尾。
*The DSH new-session preset picker lists 超级 PTC 模式 alongside the shipped modes (标准模式 / PTC 模式 / 极简模式
ew-session preset picker lists 超级 PTC 模式 alongside the shipped modes (标准模式 / PTC 模式 / 极简模式 / 创造模式).*

The only behaviour this bundle ships is that preset declaration. There is no host plugin code and no
client code. The `@local/` scope and `private: true` are intentional: this is a local profile bundl
e installed from a checkout, not a package published to npm.
## What the preset composes
### PTC presentation
The preset mounts `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation` with `mode: ptc`. For agents joined to
this preset the tool catalog collapses to the `run_code` transport plus a generated SDK: every other
tool is reachable only from inside a `run_code` program as `await tools.<name>(args)`. Independent
calls can therefore be batched in one program, which cuts round trips and keeps intermediate output
out of the conversation.
### The shipped ptc row set
The preset restates the shipped `ptc` composition so that PTC, delegation, and the doctrine stay one
es the shipped `ptc` composition so that PTC, delegation, and the doctrine stay one coherent preset:

- identity: `persona` (prefix plus the doctrine suffix), `agent-instructions`, `time-context`;
- she

ll: `pwsh` on Windows, `bash` elsewhere;
- filesystem: read/write/edit plus path and content search;

- runtime: background jobs and scheduled reminders;
- knowledge and control: skills, goals, plan mo

de, compaction (`/compact` and tool-result pruning);
- delegation: the legacy one-shot `subagent` /
`subagent_fork` / `list_agents` path stays mounted; the doctrine makes Agent Teams delegation the de

fault strategy;
- interaction: `ask_user_question`, `todo_write`, web search/fetch, `present`.
`plugin_manager` and plugin-market tools are disabled inside sessions of this preset, so the agent c
annot reconfigure its own profile from a delegated session.
### The persona suffix: delegation doctrine
The delta against the shipped `ptc` preset is the persona suffix. It is mounted inside the preset co
mposition, so it shadows the deployment persona suffix for sessions of this preset only; other prese
ts and existing chats are unaffected. It renders after the PTC SDK instructions and tool guidance, s
o the doctrine has the last word on how work is executed. The text must stay free of `{{…}}` prompt-
variable syntax because persona text is a strict template.
In short, the doctrine tells the Lead to decompose non-trivial work before acting, create shared tas
ks with acceptance criteria and disjoint write scopes before spawning, keep teammates bounded (typic
ally 1–4) with self-contained briefs, own integration and final verification, and never equate a com
pletion message with verified success.
### Host-scoped tools it relies on
Agent Teams tools are **not** declared by this bundle. They come from the host profile's `@deepseek-
ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` bundle: `spawn_teammate`, `send_message`, `list_agents`, `wa
it_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and the shared task board `team_task_create` / `list` / `get` / `updat
agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and the shared task board `team_task_create` / `list` / `get` / `update`.

osition surface the shipped `ptc` preset uses. |
| Agent Teams experimental bundle enabled (`@deepse
ek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`) | Supplies `spawn_teammate`, `send_message`, `list_agent
s`, `wait_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and the shared task board. Without it the preset still mounts,

but the team tools are absent and the doctrine is unactionable. |
| A composed PTC runtime (`@deepse
ek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node`; included in the desktop app) | A `ptc` presentation without a PTC runti
me is refused at mount time, naming the failing row. |

4. Select **Super PTC Mode** (id `super-ptc`) as the preset for a new session. Existing chats keep t

## Compatibility
Tested on the DSH desktop app **0.2.1-rc.5 on Windows**. The composition is platform-neutral where t
he shipped `ptc` preset is: it mounts `pwsh` on Windows and `bash` elsewhere, and the rest of the ro
ws are ordinary DSH plugins. UI titles and descriptions follow the DSH locale (`en` / `zh`).
